sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界一些最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上免费直播精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费体验我们所有的新闻报道一个月。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名内部举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触情况的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: Today, I am asking our chairman to proceed with articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我要求我们的主席着手起草弹劾条款。

sentences.en: I now call up House Resolution 755, impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors.
sentences.zh: 我现在宣读众议院第 755 号决议，以严重罪行和轻罪弹劾美国总统唐纳德·约翰·特朗普。

sentences.en: Do you guys want me to say Nicholas, my violin, or can I say Nick?
sentences.zh: 你们想让我说尼古拉斯、我的小提琴，还是可以说尼克？

sentences.en: No, whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 不，随你便。

sentences.en: Okay, is that right?
sentences.zh: 好的，这样可以吗？

sentences.en: Hey, it's Nick Fandos, congressional reporter for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》国会记者尼克·潘多斯。

sentences.en: I just got back from Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 我刚从国会山回来。

sentences.en: There's a bit of news over there this morning after some drama and delay.
sentences.zh: 经过一番波折和延迟后，今天早上那边传出了一些新闻。

sentences.en: Mr. Nadler?
sentences.zh: 纳德勒先生？

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Mr. Nadler votes aye.
sentences.zh: 纳德勒先生投赞成票。

sentences.en: Ms. Lofgren?
sentences.zh: 洛夫格伦女士？

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: The 40 members of the House Judiciary Committee have voted along party lines to approve two articles of impeachment against President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 众议院司法委员会的 40 名成员已按党派路线投票通过了针对唐纳德·特朗普总统的两项弹劾条款。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, there are 23 ayes and 17 noes.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，有 23 票赞成，17 票反对。

sentences.en: Basically, what they've done now is finalize what the president's going to be impeached for.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们现在所做的是敲定了弹劾总统的具体罪名。

sentences.en: Abuse of power and obstructing Congress.
sentences.zh: 滥用职权和妨碍国会。

sentences.en: And they've now voted it out of committee.
sentences.zh: 他们现在已经通过委员会投票将其提交表决。

sentences.en: The resolution is amended, is ordered, reported favorably to the House.
sentences.zh: 该决议经修正后，责令并有利地报告给众议院。

sentences.en: So that sets up an impeachment vote of the full House next week.
sentences.zh: 这就为下周全院的弹劾表决做好了准备。

sentences.en: Without objection, the committee is adjourned.
sentences.zh: 如果没有异议，委员会休会。

sentences.en: But the latest, what I've been paying attention to these last few days, is what these committee members said in their final arguments in the lead up to that vote.
sentences.zh: 但最近几天我一直关注的最新情况，是这些委员会成员在投票前的最后辩论中所说的话。

sentences.en: Starting Wednesday night, all through the day and night on Thursday, and up until the vote Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 从周三晚上开始，贯穿周四全天候，直至周五早上的投票。

sentences.en: Do you believe that we should allow this to go unaddressed, what the president did?
sentences.zh: 难道你认为我们应该对总统的行为置之不理吗？

sentences.en: Ostensibly, what was there left to say, right?
sentences.zh: 表面上看，似乎已经没什么好说的了，对吧？

sentences.en: After two months of this inquiry, weeks of debate, the committee that's comprised of some of the most ardent members of each party, they've all made up their minds long ago.
sentences.zh: 在经历了两个月的调查和数周的辩论后，由各党派最坚定的成员组成的委员会早在很久以前就下定决心了。

sentences.en: But in these last moments...
sentences.zh: 但在最后关头……

sentences.en: Let's be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说。

sentences.en: This is about our conscience.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们的良知。

sentences.en: The conscience of the nation.
sentences.zh: 国家的良知。

sentences.en: The conscience of my friends on the other side of the aisle.
sentences.zh: 我政坛对立面朋友们的良知。

sentences.en: They called on one another to reconsider their votes.
sentences.zh: 他们呼吁彼此重新考虑自己的投票。

sentences.en: And many of them did so by appealing to one another's conscience.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人通过诉诸彼此的良知来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Let's keep our eye on what really happened in this case, and whether or not our consciences dictate that we do something about it.
sentences.zh: 让我们密切关注本案中真正发生的事情，以及我们的良知是否决定了我们必须采取行动。

sentences.en: We can't let it go unaddressed.
sentences.zh: 我们不能对它置之不理。

sentences.en: Democrats appealed to the Republicans to consider their better angels.
sentences.zh: 民主党人呼吁共和党人倾听内心深处的善意。

sentences.en: And I ask my colleagues to let your conscience be your guide.
sentences.zh: 我请求我的同僚们让良知指引你们。

sentences.en: To put party aside and think about this moment in history.
sentences.zh: 把党派利益抛在一边，思考历史的这一刻。

sentences.en: Reach deep within yourselves to find the courage to do what the evidence requires and the Constitution demands to put our country above your party.
sentences.zh: 内心深处去寻找勇气，去做证据所要求、宪法所规定的事，将国家置于党派之上。

sentences.en: And the Republicans...
sentences.zh: 而共和党人……

sentences.en: Chairman, I appreciate that, Mr. Cicilline.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我很感激，西西里尼先生。

sentences.en: And I was going to make a request of my colleagues and friends on the other side as well to put country over party also.
sentences.zh: 我也打算向对面的同僚和朋友们提出一个请求，同样要把国家置于党派之上。

sentences.en: We're essentially making the exact same appeal back to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我们本质上是在向民主党人做完全相同的呼吁。

sentences.en: We're looking at the same set of facts, but two totally different ways.
sentences.zh: 我们面对的是同一套事实，却有截然不同的两种解读方式。

sentences.en: Look, the founders of this country warned against a single-party impeachment.
sentences.zh: 听着，这个国家的开国元勋曾警告过单党弹劾。

sentences.en: Put aside your partisanship.
sentences.zh: 抛开你们的党派偏见。

sentences.en: Reconsider your vote.
sentences.zh: 重新考虑你们的投票。

sentences.en: Because they feared it would bitterly and perhaps irreparably divide our nation.
sentences.zh: 因为他们担心这会给我们的国家带来痛苦且或许无法弥合的分裂。

sentences.en: A vote where everyone knew the outcome.
sentences.zh: 这是一场每个人都知道结果的投票。

sentences.en: Where not one person in that room was going to reconsider their vote.
sentences.zh: 房间里没有一个人会重新考虑自己的投票。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, there are 23 ayes and 17 no's.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，有 23 票赞成，17 票反对。

sentences.en: So here's what I think is going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为情况是这样的。

sentences.en: The members of the committee weren't really speaking to one another over these last few days.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，委员会的成员其实并不是在彼此对话。

sentences.en: They were speaking to a small handful of Democratic colleagues, maybe a Republican or two, in the full House, who don't yet know how they're going to vote.
sentences.zh: 他们是在对众议院中一小撮尚未决定如何投票的民主党同僚，或者一两个共和党人说话。

sentences.en: Or at least say they don't know how they're going to vote next week.
sentences.zh: 或者至少他们声称自己还不知道下周该如何投票。

sentences.en: These are people like Alyssa Slotkin of Michigan,
sentences.zh: 这些人包括来自密歇根州的阿莉莎·斯洛特金、

sentences.en: Jeff Van Drew of New Jersey, the Democratic moderates in swing districts, or Trump districts, the couple Democrats who never came around to supporting an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 来自新泽西州的杰夫·范德鲁，以及摇摆选区或特朗普选区的民主党温和派，还有那几个从未支持过弹劾调查的民主党人。

sentences.en: They now have to decide whether or not they're going to impeach.
sentences.zh: 他们现在必须决定是否要支持弹劾。

sentences.en: And that's a very, very risky proposition.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常非常冒险的提议。

sentences.en: And to be clear, this isn't about needing the votes in a numbers sense.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，这并不是指在数字意义上需要这些票数。

sentences.en: By all accounts, the Democrats have the votes they need to pass this on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 从各方面来看，民主党已经拥有在众议院通过此案所需的票数。

sentences.en: It's about wanting every single Democrat to vote to impeach.
sentences.zh: 这是为了让每一位民主党人都投赞成弹劾票。

sentences.en: Because that's another kind of message.
sentences.zh: 因为那是另一种讯息。

sentences.en: One to the voters who aren't sure how they feel about impeachment.
sentences.zh: 那是给那些对弹劾态度不确定的选民的讯息。

sentences.en: The same people who will have to decide whether to give Alyssa Slotkin or Jeff Van Drew another term in 2020.
sentences.zh: 正是这些人将在 2020 年决定是否让阿莉莎·斯洛特金或杰夫·范德鲁再连任一届。

sentences.en: It's a message to them that all of the Democrats, even the moderates, even the ones for whom this is politically inconvenient, are united on this front.
sentences.zh: 这是向他们传达这样一个讯息：所有的民主党人，甚至是温和派，甚至是那些政治上因此陷入困境的人，在这个问题上都是团结一致的。

sentences.en: And they hope that moderate Democrats taking a tough vote that might cost them their jobs will signal to Americans that it was the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 他们希望温和派民主党人做出可能让他们付出政治代价的艰难投票，能向美国人民发出信号，表明这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: So that's the latest from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这就是华盛顿的最新动态。

sentences.en: We expect the full House to take its vote next week, probably on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我们预计众议院全院将在下周进行投票，很可能在周三。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter 秀》节目中，我们将为假期接待亲友做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人家外如家的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要漆黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或者在你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter 秀》。
